# Mage

> Mage is a lightweight, research-friendly multimodal model family from Microsoft. It includes Mage-VL (codec-native streaming video understanding), Mage-Flow (compact image generation and editing), and Mage-VL-Cowork (a 4B hybrid computer-use agent).

## Projects

- [Mage-VL-Cowork](https://microsoft.github.io/Mage/cowork/): 4B hybrid computer-use agent (CUA) that combines GUI actions with code and terminal execution in one policy; 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified under a 50-step budget.
- [Mage-VL](https://microsoft.github.io/Mage/vl/): efficient codec-native streaming multimodal foundation model.
- [Mage-Flow](https://microsoft.github.io/Mage/flow/): compact 4B model family for native-resolution image generation and instruction-based editing, with interactive 4-step inference.

## Mage-VL-Cowork

- [Mage-VL-Cowork full text](https://microsoft.github.io/Mage/llms-full.txt): plain-text version of the Mage-VL-Cowork page (results, method, data, training recipe, FAQ).
- [Technical report (arXiv:2610.40747)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40747)
- [Real-time demo: spreadsheet editing](https://microsoft.github.io/Mage/cowork/static/videos/hybrid-vs-gui-spreadsheet.mp4)
- [Real-time demo: image editing in GIMP](https://microsoft.github.io/Mage/cowork/static/videos/hybrid-vs-gui-gimp.mp4)
